title: Invertibility of the raw restricted evaluation map
statement: The evaluation morphism from derived Hom classes to zeroth derived sections of the restricted pullback, before the explicit shift identification, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 and Cohomology on Sites Tags 072W, 0BKV and 0D6F

proof.text: Choose a bounded-below injective resolution of F; restriction preserves injectives by exact extension by zero, and the derived Yoneda and sections adjunctions identify homotopy classes with cohomology classes. Evaluation at the represented identity is this bijection.
